title: Passive self-blocking distinct-opportunity shadow reconstruction

macro_program.name: portfolio_capital_risk
macro_program.reason: The implementation decision is whether the one-position-per-component constraint hides enough distinct Passive opportunity to justify a future second-layer capacity candidate.

research_height.transfer: Passive state while one position is held -> distinct re-armed signal -> reachable limit and forward mark -> component concurrency and portfolio-capacity decision

central_question: While one Passive position is already held, does the one-position constraint suppress economically distinct re-armed Passive opportunities rather than merely duplicate the incumbent signal's persistence?

lenses: raw blocked-state signal supply versus native unblocked Passive signal supply
distinct threshold re-arm episodes and conservative four-bar limit-touch calibration
four-hour direction-normalized post-touch mark value and calendar breadth
research_bundle.common_boundary: The immutable 2026-01-01 through 2026-08-21 P4 candidate/lifecycle ledgers joined to one newly frozen US100 M15 bar snapshot; no actual close P/L is consumed.

idea_provenance.literal_premise_correction: The generic EvaluateEntryGate Path 4 yields 1,302 signal-unknown rows for five scheduled components, but it runs before their time-window gate and therefore does not identify 1,302 lost opportunities. Passive uses a separate position-management branch that continues calculating state while held. This unit narrows the hypothesis to identifiable, session-eligible Passive re-arm signals.
idea_provenance.claude_falsifier_preserved: The blocked-state raw signal-pass rate below one half of the native unblocked rate is a fixed strong null condition.

source_semantics.decision_session: The prior closed decision bar hour is at least 12 and below 16, so current evaluation bars are 12:15 through 16:00 inclusive.
source_semantics.state_formula: log(latest_close / close_12_bars_earlier) divided by sample_standard_deviation_of_96_log_returns times sqrt(12)
source_semantics.range_scale: median of the 96 completed-bar high-low ranges beginning two bars behind the current bar
source_semantics.direction: state > 0 maps to SELL (-1); state < 0 maps to BUY (+1)

data_acquisition.copy_scope: One independent physical minimal Portable containing terminal support, Config, US100 history, symbol database and tickers.dat only; no link, Tester cache, report tree, MQL family executable or Live dependency.
data_acquisition.method: One MetaTrader5 Python copy_rates_range call for US100 TIMEFRAME_M15 through the dedicated Portable.
data_acquisition.time_contract: Format the returned epoch without timezone remapping; exact parity with all 1,921 frozen Passive candidate decision_bar values decides whether the contract is valid.

native_control.population: All 1,921 Passive candidate rows with signal_known=1.
native_control.signal_pass_rate: 121 / 1,921; used as the immutable native unblocked control.

blocked_shadow_observations.enumeration: For each exactly paired Passive position, enumerate unique M15 current-bar starts after its entry-decision bar and strictly before close server time; retain current bars 12:15 through 16:00, finite reconstructible state/range, and held-bar index below 16.
blocked_shadow_observations.raw_shadow_pass: abs(state) >= 1.0 and the implied direction equals the incumbent direction. Opposite or weak states are not additional-entry opportunities.
blocked_shadow_observations.rate: raw shadow passes divided by all enumerated blocked shadow observations.

distinct_rearm_episode.definition: At most one episode per incumbent lifecycle: after birth the held-state path must first record abs(state) < 1.0, then a later session-eligible bar must re-cross abs(state) >= 1.0 in the incumbent direction before close and held-bar 16.
distinct_rearm_episode.reason: This excludes immediate persistence of the entry signal and asks whether a genuinely reset and renewed opportunity is hidden.

limit_price_and_touch.rounding: BUY floors and SELL ceils to the acquired trade tick size, normalized to acquired symbol digits.
limit_price_and_touch.proxy_window: Current M15 bar plus the following three M15 bars, matching the four-bar activation lifetime.
limit_price_and_touch.touch_rule: BUY uses low + spread_points * point <= limit; SELL uses high >= limit.
limit_price_and_touch.control_calibration: Classify all 119 native PENDING_ORDER rows against the 92 actual Passive births reachable before expiry. Require sensitivity >= 0.90 and specificity >= 0.70 before applying the proxy to shadow episodes.

forward_mark.population: Distinct re-arm episodes whose limit has a calibrated proxy touch and whose complete sixteen-bar response exists.
forward_mark.measure: direction * (close at the end of the sixteenth M15 bar including touch bar - limit_price) / signal range_scale
forward_mark.support: Pooled mean, median and calendar-month means only; no stop, cost, realized fill, actual lifecycle or portfolio P/L is imputed.

requirements: Every immutable input retains its exact size/hash and the dedicated runtime has zero links or shared mutable family/Live dependencies.
The bar export has unique strictly increasing epochs, exact declared columns, finite positive OHLC, valid high/low topology, nonnegative volume/spread and no row beyond the fixed boundary.
All 1,921 Passive control decision bars join exactly; reconstructed feature maximum absolute difference is <= 1e-9 and all 1,921 signal-pass classifications match.
All 119 native pending-order limit prices reconstruct within one acquired tick and the observed fill anchor remains exactly 92.
All 92 Passive births and closes pair uniquely and every derived blocked observation belongs to exactly one interval.
The native fill-touch calibration reaches sensitivity >= 0.90 and specificity >= 0.70 before shadow touch or forward-mark metrics are authoritative.

any_condition: raw shadow pass rate is below one half of native control
distinct re-arm episodes are at most 10
proxy touch rate is below 0.30 after valid calibration
with at least 15 touched episodes both pooled mean and median four-hour marks are <= 0

decision_translation.if_material_gate_passes: Freeze exactly one future Lab candidate allowing at most one second Passive layer; it still requires a separately declared full-portfolio real-tick intervention before any policy claim.
decision_translation.if_strong_null_triggers: Preserve the one-position Passive constraint and close the self-blocking axis.
decision_translation.if_ambiguous: Preserve the constraint and retain no candidate; do not open a nearby threshold, session, episode or horizon rescue.
decision_translation.if_invalid: Preserve the constraint and state only the observation gap; do not repair the family after outcomes.

stop_rules: Commit and push declaration, state and Frontier memory before runtime copy, symbol_info, bar acquisition or any shadow metric.
Freeze acquisition receipt, symbol spec and bar export in Git before the single aggregation.
If acquisition produces no usable output, the one allowed premetric correction may address acquisition or serialization only; no metric definition, threshold, population or decision may change.
If any input, time, feature, order-price, interval or touch-calibration integrity gate fails, stop before authoritative shadow value metrics and close invalid.
Do not access actual/stressed close economics, add another period/component/variant, create MQL/test infrastructure, or touch Live, broker/account state or Program 6.
automatic_followups_not_opened: alternate re-arm threshold, gap, session, touch window or mark horizon
full-portfolio candidate execution even if the observational gate passes
